evals.name: new-case-memblock-cross16b-boundary
evals.prompt: 使用 hyptest-workflow skill。test_point_file=test_point/memblock_suspected_bug_corner_points_14.md, platform=spike, spec_profile=nhv5_1_ap, task_mode=new-case-only, new_case_count=1, target_policy=default-first, target_module=memblock。要求：新增 1 个 ### PnX 测试点，检查 same-page cross-16B `sd(1B+7B)` 在 repeated SAF → repair → upper-half aligned `sd(8B)` success → refault SAF → repair → retried `sd(1B+7B)` success 序列下，boundary image（guard_before/boundary/guard_after）是否保持。新增 1 个 ai_micro_* case，走预热+轻量直通路径；Spike 跑通按 default 落位。
evals.expected_output: 新 ### PnX 条目 + 新 ai_micro_* case + Spike 编译/运行通过 + test_register.c 启用 + test_point 轻量回填 + test_point → case 映射表 + 最终决策写在摘要
expectations: The output adds a new `### P` entry under test_point/memblock_suspected_bug_corner_points_14.md that did not exist before
The new test point is NOT a copy of an existing one in the same file
A new ai_micro_* case function is added to ai_test_cases/*.c
The new case function contains exactly one TEST_END(...)
TEST_SETUP_EXCEPT() is called before any excpt.* assertion in the new case
test_register.c contains a TEST_REGISTER line for the new case (enabled, not commented)
compile_elf.py was invoked with --plat spike --name <new_case_name>
get_result.py was invoked with --platform spike --case <new_case_name>
Spike run log contains PASSED (from .tmp/result_log/spike/*.log)
The test_point entry body mentions boundary/guard/adjacent preservation
Repo-level similar-case search was performed before writing (via find_similar_cases.py or repo_evidence_index.py)
check_case_uniqueness.py --expect absent was run on the new case name before writing
The final delivery summary contains a test_point → case mapping table (each test_point requirement mapped to a specific TEST_ASSERT line)
The spec_profile used (nhv5_1_ap) is recorded in the final summary
check_writeback_format.py --check-register was run after writeback
If the final decision is not default, a reason_code from references/reason_code_catalog.md is given; if default, no decision_prelim/decision_final block is emitted

evals.name: supplement-existing-p6b-assert
evals.prompt: 使用 hyptest-workflow skill。test_point_file=test_point/memblock_suspected_bug_corner_points_14.md, platform=spike, spec_profile=nhv5_1_ap, task_mode=supplement-existing-point, target_test_point="### P6B" (or whichever existing ### PnX entry is in that file — pick the first one that lacks a boundary assertion)。要求：在指定旧条目下，给已有的 ai_micro_* case 补充 1 条面向邻接地址 preserve 的断言（用 adjacent / guard / boundary 作为断言文案关键词），不新增测试点，不改变 case 函数名。写完后单 case 编译 + 运行。
evals.expected_output: 修改已有 ai_micro_* case 添加邻接断言 + 未新增 ### PnX 条目 + 未改 test_register.c（case 名不变）+ Spike 跑通 + test_point → case 映射表更新体现新断言
expectations: No new `### P` entry is added to the test_point file (supplement mode, not new-case)
An existing ai_micro_* case function is modified, not renamed or duplicated
The modification adds at least one TEST_ASSERT containing adjacent / guard / boundary / neighbor / preserve keyword
The modified case still has exactly one TEST_END
TEST_SETUP_EXCEPT() placement (if the case reads excpt.*) is preserved or correctly added
test_register.c is NOT modified (case name did not change, registration status did not change)
compile_elf.py --plat spike --name <case_name> was invoked on the modified case
get_result.py --platform spike --case <case_name> was invoked
Spike run log contains PASSED
The final summary notes this was a supplement-existing-point task (not a new test point)
The test_point → case mapping table in the final summary shows the new assertion line mapped to a boundary/preservation requirement
coverage_scope is file (not repo) — supplement mode default

evals.name: bug-hunt-storequeue-uncovered-neighbor
evals.prompt: 使用 hyptest-workflow skill。target_module=StoreQueue, platform=spike, spec_profile=nhv5_1_ap, task_mode=new-case-only, new_case_count=1, target_policy=default-first, test_point_file=test_point/StoreQueue_suspected_bug_corner_points_1.md（若不存在则创建）。要求：围绕 StoreQueue 模块找 1 个高价值 suspected bug 点。按 SKILL.md Bug Hunt Evidence 段的三类资料定位可疑点：profile §5 高风险类别 + target_module 的 RTL 源码 anti-pattern + 现有 test_point 覆盖空隙。新增 1 个 ### PnX 条目和 1 个 ai_micro_* case，怀疑点段用自然语言说明
evals.expected_output: 选点所用的证据来源（profile §5 哪条 / 源码哪个 anti-pattern / 现有 test_point 覆盖空隙）+ 新 ### PnX（含 `<file>.scala:<line>` 怀疑点）+ 新 ai_micro_* case + 编译运行 + 映射表
expectations: Before selecting candidates, the target_module spelling is validated against the RTL source tree (ls/find under $HYPTEST_LINKNAN_HOME/dependencies/nanhu/src/main)
The final summary cites evidence source(s) from at least one of: profile §5 category, RTL anti-pattern at a specific .scala:line, uncovered area in existing test_point
The new test_point entry body contains a '怀疑点' (or 'suspected point' / 'RTL path') section
The 怀疑点 section references at least one concrete `<file>.scala:<line>` with a natural-language reason for suspicion
The file:line reference resolves to a .scala file under LinkNan/Nanhu source tree
The summary does NOT claim '已验证 bug' without evidence — speculation is labeled as speculation in plain language
A new ### P entry is added to the test_point file (new-case-only)
The new test_point entry is NOT a duplicate of an existing one (checked via repo-level test_point coverage)
A new ai_micro_* case function is added to ai_test_cases/*.c with exactly one TEST_END
TEST_SETUP_EXCEPT() is present before excpt.* assertions
test_register.c is updated with the new case
compile_elf.py and get_result.py were both invoked on the new case

Final summary records: used spec_profile, uniqueness evidence (test_point coverage + case similarity top results + function-name uniqueness), test_point → case assertion mapping table, compile/run result, final decision
If no high-value bug point was found, the summary explicitly says '未发现新的测试点 / 未新增 case' rather than fabricating a new entry
